steps.name: Pesquisar
steps.task: Find swing trade opportunities using only Yahoo Finance, Bloomberg, Reuters or Google Finance. Every quote carries its link and exact timestamp.

steps.name: Consenso
steps.task: Cross the target price of at least two analysts for each opportunity.

steps.name: Risco
steps.task: Set the stop loss and the take profit for each opportunity.

steps.name: Ordenar ao worker
steps.task: Order trader-worker to record the watchlist or the swing orders, then read the sheet and confirm what was written.

steps.name: Relatório
steps.task: Hand trader the audited swing report with links and risk levels.
